title: Integer to words
statementMd:
Convert an integer `0 <= n < 10**9` to English words, e.g. `1234` -> `"One Thousand Two Hundred Thirty Four"`. No `and`, words capitalised and separated by single spaces; zero is `"Zero"`.

**Example:** `number_to_words(123)` returns `"One Hundred Twenty Three"`.
hints: Handle chunks of three digits with a scale word.

tests.expected: One Million Two Hundred Thirty Four Thousand Five Hundred Sixty Seven
